title: Fourier spectral sample
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its Fourier spectral sample is the probability distribution on subsets of the coordinate set that assigns each subset $S$ probability equal to the Fourier weight of the real-valued version of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
